stem: An order of €300 had the path paid search → social → paid search. Under linear attribution, how much does paid search get?

options.text: €150, half the order, as one of the two channels in the path
€200, a third of the order for each of its two touches
€100, a third of the order, as a repeat touch counts once
€300, the whole order, as it was both the first and the last touch
